text:
Caroline: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a longhaul modularization approach: split runtime into three lanes (hotpath runtime, stateful session sidecar, control/telemetry spine). rough plan below, want feedback before i draft the RFC proper.
Samir: +1 on idea. main ask: what's the rollback and safety story?
Caroline: Rollback: feature-flag per-route + global kill-switch. phased cohorts so we can revert at router without DB changes.
Maria: Are we keeping the single session store for now? cross-service txs worry me.
Oren: Prefer adding a tenancy-demux in front of the sidecar to avoid changing transactions early. tradeoff: ~2–6ms extra hop.
Samir: latency constraint reminder — hotpath p95 must remain <50ms. any change adding >5ms needs different optimization.
Priya: Observability concern: sidecar duplication makes tracing noisy. How do we keep a single trace and meaningful spans?
Caroline: Instrumentation rule: propagate X-Request-ID and span_id; tag spans with lane and routing_version. mandate contract tests validating trace headers.
Jin: I'll add a "contract-suite" job: run RPC contract tests against a mock sidecar and the real runtime. ensures KV semantics and error behaviors.
Samir: Deploy plan? bubbles or big-bang?
Caroline: Bubbles. timeline: phase 0 (dev spike), phase 1 enable sidecar behind flag for alpha cohort, phase 2 migrate low-traffic tenants weekly, phase 3 scale and prune legacy endpoints. 2-week burn per cohort, metrics gating at each step.
Maria: Tech-debt paydown: mark deprecated endpoints with TTL when cohort cutovers begin. schedule a 3-month deprecation window and an API-deprecation dashboard.
Oren: Cost/infra: sidecars for small tenants will add memory and sockets. consider a shared sidecar pool for tiny tenants to reduce overhead.
Priya: Security/KMS: key access model will change if sidecar holds session encryption keys. need a zero-downtime rotate plan and updated audit hooks.
Caroline: Agreed. I'll include KMS rotation and audit requirements in the RFC. also need rollback SLOs: p95 latency delta < 10%, error rate < 0.5% above baseline, no regression in trace completeness.
Samir: I'll own the rollout automation (router feature flags and cohort management).
Maria: I'll own contract-suite tests and the deprecation dashboard.
Oren: I'll spike the tenancy-demux and run latency sims against shared-pool vs per-tenant sidecars.
Jin: I'll wire up the CI job for contract-suite and a small harness for error-mode fuzzing.
Caroline: Awesome — i'll draft the RFC with a phased checklist, gating metrics, fail-open/fail-closed options, and an automation playbook. will post link here when it's ready. :rocket:
Caroline: example rollout snippet for staging (rough):
```json
{"rollout_policy": {"cohort": "alpha", "min_healthy": 0.95, "kill_switch_route": "/_ops/disable-sidecar"}, "observability": {"propagate_headers": ["X-Request-ID", "X-Trace-ID"], "span_tag": "lane"}}
```
Samir: lgtm, want to see the checklist and the exact gating queries before we start.
Caroline: will add those (p95, p99, error %, cost delta, trace completeness). thanks all.
